text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B and C at a gain felt rewarding, but I should decide whether to sell using my plan and portfolio risk—not the satisfaction of realizing a profit.","I later bought B and C again at lower prices; that does not by itself prove either decision was right. I should assess each position on its merits, without anchoring on my cost basis or past trades.","The account’s losses and partial recovery offer no reliable signal about what comes next. I should review holdings periodically, keep diversification in mind, and avoid trading on price patterns that may be random."]}
